assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original wide background illustration for Hall da Fama of a sophisticated dark fantasy RPG website. Primary request: a prestigious, intimate Hall of Heroes, cohesive with a medieval shop and stables painted in warm natural materials. Scene: well proportioned stone gallery with three shallow arched alcoves, elegant aged bronze laurel details and a few carefully placed wall candles. Empty stone floor and empty foreground; actual player portraits and podiums will be overlaid by the website. Style: excellent hand-painted fantasy game environment with deliberate brushwork, believable masonry, controlled detail and architectural perspective. Warm amber candlelight, rich charcoal, desaturated burgundy, weathered bronze. Wide landscape, eye-level camera, balanced composition and subdued negative space in the center and lower half. The room should convey earned honor and history, not ostentatious royal luxury. No characters, no statues, no throne, no lettering, no cards, no UI, no symbols that look like text, no excessive fog, no chaotic props, no watermarks. Subtle shadows, exquisite material detail. Output wide high-resolution opaque image.
